title: Harry-potter-1
author: J.K. Rowling
description:
Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone is the first book in the famous series by J.K. Rowling.
It follows a lonely orphan who discovers he is a famous wizard.
He leaves his cruel family for a magical school, where he becomes best friends with Ron Weasley and Hermione Granger , and together, they stop an evil dark lord.

title: Harry-potter-2
author: J.K. Rowling
description:
Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets is the second book in the famous series by J.K. Rowling. It follows Harry Potter, the lonely orphan who discovers he is a famous wizard.
He navigates his second year of school, but there is a threat to the school. With Ron Weasley and Hermione Granger , the Chamber of Secrets will be closed,.......or will it?

title: Harry-potter-3
author: J.K. Rowling
description:
Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban is the third book in the famous series by J.K. Rowling. It follows Harry Potter, the lonely orphan who discovers he is a famous wizard.
He navigates his third year of school, but there is a threat to the school. There are Dementors everywhere, and a villain.....who wants his blood.

title: Harry-potter-4
author: J.K. Rowling
description:
Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire follows 14-year-old Harry as he is mysteriously forced to compete in the dangerous
Triwizard Tournament against older students from three magical schools
This pivotal story marks a dark turning point in the series, culminating in the tragic death of a classmate
and the physical resurrection of Lord Voldemort.

title: Harry-potter-5
author: J.K. Rowling
description:
Harry faces a dark, dangerous fifth year at Hogwarts as Voldemort's return is denied by many.
Harry battles the Dark Lord's influence, aided by a secret order at Grimmauld Place
and Occlumency lessons, all while navigating growing threats and limited time.

title: Harry-potter-6
author: J.K. Rowling
description:
Dumbledore returns with a mysterious injury to guide Harry through Voldemort's past
as threats loom over Hogwarts, with Harry suspecting Malfoy is a Death Eater.
The story focuses on exploring the Dark Lord's to prepare for the final conflict.

title: Harry-potter-7
author: J.K. Rowling
description:
Harry leaves the safety of Privet Drive to face Voldemort, as the protective
charms are broken and the final battle begins. He must hunt down the remaining
Horcruxes to destroy the Dark Lord and end the threat, concluding the series.

title: Percy Jackson 1
author: Rick Riordan
description:
Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief is the first book in the hit fantasy series by Rick Riordan. It follows a troubled, dyslexic boy who discovers he is actually a demigod—the
son of the Greek god Poseidon. He leaves his difficult mortal life for a secret training camp, where he becomes best friends with Annabeth Chase and Grover Underwood, and together, they embark on a dangerous quest across America to find Zeus's stolen master bolt and prevent an apocalyptic war among the gods.

title: Percy Jackson 2
author: Rick Riordan
description: Percy Jackson and the Sea of Monsters is the second book in the famous series by Rick Riordan. It follows demigod Percy Jackson, his friend Annabeth Chase, and his cyclops half-brother Tyson as they journey into the dangerous Sea of Monsters (the Bermuda Triangle) to find the magical Golden Fleece and save Camp Half-Blood from being destroyed.

title: Percy Jackson 3
author: Rick Riordan
description:
The Titan's Curse is the action-packed third installment in Rick Riordan's Percy Jackson & the Olympians series.
In this fantasy adventure novel, Percy Jackson, Thalia Grace, and Grover Underwood rescue two new demigods, but Annabeth Chase and the goddess Artemis are captured by the Titan army.
A dangerous quest ensues to save them before the winter solstice.

title: Percy Jackson 4
author: Rick Riordan
description:
The Battle of the Labyrinth is the high-stakes fourth installment in Rick Riordan's Percy Jackson & the Olympians series.
As the final war against the Titans looms, Percy and his friends must navigate a deadly, shape-shifting underground maze to stop a catastrophic invasion of Camp Half-Blood.
This pivotal adventure deepens the conflict and tests the characters' courage and loyalties.

title: Percy Jackson 5
author: Rick Riordan
description:
In The Last Olympian by Rick Riordan, Percy Jackson turns sixteen, bathes in the River Styx for invulnerability, and leads an army of young demigods to defend New York City and Mount Olympus against the Titan lord Kronos.
This final book in the original series forces the teenage heroes to hold Manhattan entirely on their own while the Olympian gods are lured away to fight a different cosmic threat, ultimately requiring a fateful decision for the future of Olympus.

title: Percy Jackson 6
author: Rick Riordan
description:
In The Chalice of the Gods by Rick Riordan, a 17-year-old Percy Jackson tries to navigate a normal senior year of high school while embarking on a quest to secure three divine letters of recommendation required for admission into New Rome University.
This sixth installment of the original series reunites the classic trio of Percy, Annabeth, and Grover as they search for the missing magical goblet of Ganymede, the cupbearer of the gods, before a mortal drinks from it and gains unintended immortality.

title: Percy Jackson 7
author: Rick Riordan
description:
Wrath of the Triple Goddess by Rick Riordan follows senior high schooler Percy Jackson as he tries to earn his second college recommendation letter for New Rome University.
To secure it, Percy, Annabeth, and Grover must house-sit and pet-sit for the goddess Hecate over Halloween week.
However, the seemingly simple chore quickly turns disastrous when Hecate's ancient, magical pets escape into New York City, leaving the trio to hunt them down before the goddess returns.

title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid
author: Jeff Kinney
description: In Diary of a Wimpy Kid, Greg Heffley starts middle school and records his daily struggles in a hilarious journal. As he tries to become popular, he lands in one embarrassing situation after another with his best friend, Rowley, and learns that growing up is never as easy as it seems.

title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Rodrick Rules
author: Jeff Kinney
description: In Rodrick Rules, the story focuses on Greg's annoying older brother, Rodrick, who holds a very embarrassing secret over Greg's head. The siblings eventually form a shaky truce after surviving a wild house party together.

title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: The Last Straw
author: Jeff Kinney
description: In The Last Straw, Greg's dad tries to toughen him up by threatening to send him to military school. Greg barely escapes enlistment by making a last-minute impression on his father.

title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Dog Days
author: Jeff Kinney
description: In Dog Days, Greg wants to stay inside playing video games during summer vacation, but his mom forces him outdoors. His summer gets worse when a country club mishap leaves him with a massive debt.

title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: The Ugly Truth
author: Jeff Kinney
description: In The Ugly Truth, Greg and Rowley have a falling out, and Greg has to face the responsibilities of growing up. He must navigate the horrors of a school lock-in and a changing body without his best friend.

title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Cabin Fever
author: Jeff Kinney
description: In Cabin Fever, a massive blizzard traps Greg's family inside their house, and Greg worries he is in trouble with the police. The claustrophobic family dynamic quickly turns into a funny battle for survival.

title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: The Third Wheel
author: Jeff Kinney
description: In The Third Wheel, a school Valentine's Day dance leaves Greg looking for a date so he isn't left out with Rowley. The night ends in disaster when Rowley unexpectedly wins over Greg's dream date.

title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Hard Luck
author: Jeff Kinney
description: In Hard Luck, Rowley gets a new girlfriend, leaving Greg behind to find new friends using a Magic 8-ball. Greg is forced to rely on pure luck and superstition to survive the school year alone.

title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: The Long Haul
author: Jeff Kinney
description: In The Long Haul, the Heffley family goes on a disastrous road trip in a beat-up van. They encounter rogue seagulls, a broken-down car, and a terrifying family they call the "Beardos".

title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Old School
author: Jeff Kinney
description: In Old School, Greg goes on a tough outdoor field trip and the town tries to live without electronics. He struggles to adapt to the wilderness while hunting for a mythical forest monster.

title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Double Down
author: Jeff Kinney
description: In Double Down, Greg tries to make a movie to get famous after his mom pressures him to find a creative hobby. His amateur horror film project ends up causing mass panic in the neighborhood.

title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: The Getaway
author: Jeff Kinney
description: In The Getaway, Greg suffers through a terrible holiday resort trip with his family to escape the winter cold. What was supposed to be a relaxing vacation turns into a stressful chase by resort security.

title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: The Meltdown
author: Jeff Kinney
description: In The Meltdown, a massive neighborhood snow war erupts, creating turf battles between rival streets. Greg and Rowley must defend their snow fort against an army of neighborhood kids.

title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Wrecking Ball
author: Jeff Kinney
description: In Wrecking Ball, an unexpected inheritance allows the Heffley family to renovate and expand their house. The construction process becomes a total nightmare filled with toxic mold and angry wasps.

title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: The Deep End
author: Jeff Kinney
description: In The Deep End, the Heffleys go on a chaotic summer camp trip using their uncle's old camper van. They find themselves completely out of their element at a packed, dysfunctional RV park.

title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Big Shot
author: Jeff Kinney
description: In Big Shot, Greg joins a hopeless basketball team after a disastrous tryout session. Against all odds, Greg is handed the ball for the final shot of the championship game.

title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Diper Överlöde
author: Jeff Kinney
description: In Diper Överlöde, Greg goes on tour with Rodrick's rock band to help them achieve fame. He quickly realizes the rock-and-roll lifestyle is just hard work and zero glamour.

title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: No Brainer
author: Jeff Kinney
description: In No Brainer, Greg deals with major school budget cuts that threaten to close his school down. He has to step up to save his school from being shut down permanently.

title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Hot Mess
author: Jeff Kinney
description: In Hot Mess, Greg faces a sweltering summer packed with family mishaps when his entire family squeezes into a tiny beach house. He must survive the cramped, chaotic vacation while trying to uncover the closely guarded secret behind his grandmother's legendary meatball recipe.

title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Partypooper
author: Jeff Kinney
description: In Partypooper, the story centers around a milestone birthday celebration for Greg that quickly turns into a total side-splitting disaster. He has to deal with the overwhelming social pressure and awkward family traditions that come with turning another year older.

title: The Brilliant World of Tom Gates
author: Liz Pichon
description: In The Brilliant World of Tom Gates, Tom avoids homework, draws doodles, and tries to see his favorite band Dude3 while dealing with his teacher Mr. Fullerman and rival Marcus.

title: Excellent Excuses (and Other Good Stuff)
author: Liz Pichon
description: In Excellent Excuses (And Other Good Stuff), Tom makes up funny excuses for missing work while planning a fun spring break with his best friend Derek.

title: Everything's Amazing (Sort Of)
author: Liz Pichon
description: In Everything's Amazing (sort of), Tom tries to survive a weird family birthday and his sister Delia while working on school projects.

title: Genius Ideas (Mostly)
author: Liz Pichon
description: In Genius Ideas (Mostly), Tom prepares for sports day and tries to get his band DogZombies ready for the school talent show.

title: Tom Gates Is Absolutely Fantastic (at Some Things)
author: Liz Pichon
description: In Tom Gates is Absolutely Fantastic (at some things), Tom forgets his school trip permission form and tries hard not to mess up the upcoming outdoor adventure.

title: Tom Gates: Extra Special Treats (not)
author: Liz Pichon
description: In Tom Gates Extra Special Treats (... not), Tom hunts for treats and tries to stay out of trouble with grumpy teachers and his sister.

title: Tom Gates: A Tiny Bit Lucky
author: Liz Pichon
description: In A Tiny Bit Lucky, Tom deals with a broken-down family car, lost items, and trying to win a school competition.

title: Tom Gates: Yes! No (Maybe...)
author: Liz Pichon
description: In Yes! No (Maybe...), Tom faces chaotic family holiday plans and tries to balance his doodling with actual responsibilities.

title: Tom Gates: Top of the Class (Nearly)
author: Liz Pichon
description: In Top of the Class (Nearly), Tom aims to get better school grades while dodging embarrassing moments with his classmates.

title: Tom Gates: Super Good Skills (Almost...)
author: Liz Pichon
description: In Super Good Skills (Almost...), Tom tries to master new skills and help out around the house without causing total disaster.

title: Tom Gates: DogZombies Rule (for Now)
author: Liz Pichon
description: In DogZombies Rule (For now), the band DogZombies works hard to write an actual hit song for an upcoming performance.

title: Tom Gates: Family, Friends and Furry Creatures
author: Liz Pichon
description: In Family, Friends and Furry Creatures, Tom's house gets chaotic with various family members, pets, and unexpected visits.

title: Tom Gates: Epic Adventure (Kind Of)
author: Liz Pichon
description: In Epic Adventure (kind of), Tom goes on a chaotic family camping trip filled with weather issues and funny mishaps.

title: Tom Gates: Biscuits, Bands and Very Big Plans
author: Liz Pichon
description: In Biscuits, Bands and Very Big Plans, Tom focuses on snack breaks and ambitious plans to make his band famous.

title: Tom Gates: What Monster?
author: Liz Pichon
description: In What Monster?, Tom deals with strange noises, school projects, and avoiding trouble at home.

title: Tom Gates: Mega Make and Do (and Stories Too!)
author: Liz Pichon
description: In Mega Make and Do (and Stories Too!), Tom shares his crazy craft ideas, doodles, and short stories.

title: Tom Gates: Spectacular School Trip (Really!)
author: Liz Pichon
description: In Spectacular School Trip (Really.), Tom survives a hilarious and action-packed school journey away from home.

title: Tom Gates: Ten Tremendous Tales
author: Liz Pichon
description: In Ten Tremendous Tales, readers get a collection of ten short, funny stories packed with Tom’s signature drawings.

title: Tom Gates: Random Acts of Fun
author: Liz Pichon
description: In Random Acts of Fun, Tom creates random mischief and fun while trying to survive everyday school life.

title: Tom Gates: Happy to Help (eventually)
author: Liz Pichon
description: In Happy to Help (eventually), Tom reluctantly tries to help out family and friends with mixed, funny results.

title: Tom Gates: Five Star Stories (Hooray!)
author: Liz Pichon
description: In Five Star Stories (Hooray!), Tom presents more short, chaotic stories filled with food, doodles, and school adventures.

title: Tom Gates: Book of Everything!
author: Liz Pichon
description: In Book of Everything, a special compilation provides extra games, guides, and fun facts about Tom's world.

title: Tom Gates: Ha! Ha! Hilarious!
author: Liz Pichon
description: In Tom Gates Ha!, Tom faces new everyday embarrassments and hilarious classroom mix-ups.

title: Tom Gates: Pesky Pets and Parties (Hopefully)
author: Liz Pichon
description: In Pesky Pets and Parties, DogZombies gets ready for a big end-of-term party battle of the bands while handling annoying pets.

title: Agastya
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha comic Agastya tells the life and legends of the revered Vedic sage Agastya, a foundational figure in Hindu mythology known for his immense spiritual power, ascetic discipline, and contributions to South Indian culture. He is celebrated as a powerful hermit who used his divine abilities to protect humanity and restore cosmic balance.

title: Akbar
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha comic Akbar chronicles the life of Jalaluddin Muhammad Akbar, tracing his transformation from a carefree child into one of India's most influential Mughal emperors. The book highlights how he balanced raw military dominance with progressive governance, earning him the title 'Akbar the Great.' He is depicted as a visionary monarch who prioritised religious tolerance, cultural harmony, and structural unity across a massive, diverse empire.

title: Aniruddha
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha comic Aniruddha narrates the legendary Puranic love story and military conflict centered around Aniruddha, the noble grandson of Lord Krishna and son of Pradyumna. Based on the Bhagavata Purana, the comic details how a secret romance between a prince and a demon princess escalates into an epic clash involving the highest gods. It highlights themes of love, devotion, and the historical intersections between different ancient clans.

title: Ashoka
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha comic Ashoka chronicles the dramatic transformation of India's most famous Mauryan emperor, from a ruthless conqueror into a legendary apostle of peace. The narrative highlights how his devastating military campaigns ultimately led to a profound spiritual awakening, shaping the cultural and ethical fabric of ancient India. He is celebrated for turning Buddhism into a global movement while embedding principles of non-violence, social justice, and animal welfare deep into the laws of his empire.

title: Battle of Wits
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha comic Battle of Wits presents a collection of insightful Buddhist Jataka tales centered on the childhood adventures of Aushadha Kumar. He is a Bodhisattva born with extraordinary wisdom and an innate sense of justice. The narrative details how this young prodigy outsmarts corrupt adults and political rivals, proving that intellect and moral clarity are far mightier than malice.

title: Bheema and Hanuman
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha comic Bheema and Hanuman narrates the legendary meeting between two mighty sons of Vayu, the wind god, from different cosmic eras. Set during the Mahabharata, the story beautifully blends humility, brotherly affection, and divine strength. It serves as a classic lesson on overcoming ego, as the powerful Pandava prince Bheema encounters his older, immortal brother, Hanuman, disguised as an frail old monkey.

title: Bheeshma
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha comic Bheeshma chronicles the tragic, noble life of the grand patriarch of the Mahabharata, originally named Devavrata. It highlights his unmatched martial skill, unyielding righteousness, and the supreme sacrifice that redefined his entire destiny. He is depicted as a towering tragic hero bound by an unbreakable vow of celibacy and loyalty to the throne, forcing him to witness the destruction of his own family.

title: Drona
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha comic Drona chronicles the brilliant yet tragic life of the supreme military preceptor of the Mahabharata. It explores his journey from a poverty-stricken Brahmin youth to the legendary master of warfare who trained both the Pandavas and the Kauravas. The narrative masterfully highlights his unmatched martial genius, the bitter personal rivalries that fueled his ambitions, and the deep emotional conflict of fighting against his favorite pupils.

title: Ganga
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha comic Ganga narrates the divine origin, descent, and earthly manifestations of India's most sacred river goddess. The story highlights her essential role in purifying humanity, restoring cosmic balance, and acting as a spiritual lifeline across different generations. She is depicted as a powerful, compassionate celestial entity who willingly binds her destiny to the mortal realm to bring salvation to the ancestral souls of the Ikshvaku dynasty.

title: Ghatotkacha
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha comic Ghatotkacha tells the heroic and tragic story of the mighty half-demon warrior who became one of the greatest assets to the Pandavas. Born to the Pandava prince Bheema and the Asura princess Hidimbi, he possesses incredible magical powers, immense physical strength, and fierce loyalty. The narrative highlights his deep devotion to his family and his ultimate, selfless sacrifice during the Kurukshetra war.

title: The Gita
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha comic The Gita captures the profound philosophical dialogue between Lord Krishna and the Pandava prince Arjuna on the battlefield of Kurukshetra. Based on the Bhagavad Gita, the narrative serves as a spiritual guide on duty, righteousness, and the nature of the soul. It highlights the moment Arjuna suffers a crisis of conscience and collapses in grief, prompting Krishna to impart timeless wisdom to help him overcome his despair.

title: Hanuman
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha comic Hanuman captures the extraordinary life, superhuman exploits, and profound humility of the beloved Vanara deity. Based on the Ramayana, the narrative illustrates how Hanuman channels his massive physical strength and magical intellect into absolute, selfless devotion to Lord Rama. He stands as the ultimate symbol of loyalty, courage, and service, using his divine abilities entirely to protect righteousness.

title: Hanuman To The Rescue
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha comic Hanuman to the Rescue focuses entirely on the high-stakes, race-against-time mission from the Ramayana where Hanuman saves the life of Lord Rama's brother. It highlights his immense physical strength, sharp intellect, and absolute devotion as he faces various deadly obstacles. The narrative captures how a single, impossible task turns into a legendary demonstration of courage and willpower.

title: Harishchandra
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha comic Harishchandra details the legendary story of the king of Ayodhya, who sacrificed his entire kingdom, wealth, and family to uphold the absolute truth. Based on the Puranas, the narrative serves as the ultimate testament to integrity, moral fortitude, and unyielding virtue under extreme hardship. Harishchandra's unwavering adherence to his word, despite facing unimaginable suffering, cements his legacy as Satya Harishchandra (the truthful Harishchandra).

title: Jallianwala Bagh
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha comic Jallianwala Bagh recounts one of the darkest and most defining tragedies in India’s freedom struggle. Through historic illustrations, it details the horrific events of April 13, 1919, when a peaceful public gathering was brutally attacked by British colonial forces. The book focuses on how this single, devastating event permanently scarred Indo-British relations and served as a major catalyst that united the entire nation to fight relentlessly for absolute independence.

title: Krishna
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha comic Krishna chronicles the extraordinary life and divine exploits of the eighth avatar of Lord Vishnu, from his miraculous birth to his supreme role in the Mahabharata war. The book portrays him as the ultimate protector, a playful cowherd, a clever strategist, and a philosophical guide. He is celebrated for his charm, his unmatched wisdom, and his lifelong mission to destroy tyranny and establish righteousness on Earth.

title: Kumbhakarna
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha comic Kumbhakarna highlights the tragic, noble life of the giant brother of the demon king Ravana. The narrative paints him not just as a terrifying monster, but as a loyal, wise, and honorable warrior caught in an intense moral dilemma. While he openly condemns Ravana’s unrighteous actions, his fierce family devotion compels him to fight for Lanka, ultimately framing him as an incredibly complex character.

title: Mahabharata
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha comic series Mahabharata chronicles India's greatest epic, tracing the bitter rivalry between two sets of royal cousins: the righteous Pandavas and the ambitious Kauravas. The narrative serves as a profound exploration of righteousness (Dharma), duty, and destiny. It details how personal greed and political corruption escalate a family dispute into a catastrophic world war that reshapes the entire subcontinent.

title: Rabindranatah Tagore
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha (ACK) biography titled Rabindranath Tagore provides a beautifully illustrated look into the life of the legendary polymath. Originally published in 1977 and edited by Anant Pai, the comic introduces young readers to Tagore’s creative genius, philosophical depth, and contribution to India's cultural landscape. By blending historic milestones with intimate personal anecdotes, the narrative masterfully brings his journey from a sensitive, nature-loving child to a global literary icon alive for children.

title: Rana Pratap
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha (ACK) biography titled Rana Pratap is a powerful, illustrated tribute to the 16th-century Rajput warrior-king of Mewar. Originally scripted by Yagya Sharma with art by Pratap Mulick, the comic introduces readers to his legendary defiance against the mighty Mughal Emperor Akbar. By showcasing his iron will, the book masterfully illustrates the heavy personal sacrifices he made to protect his motherland's independence.

title: Savitri
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha (ACK) mythological comic titled Savitri is a beautifully illustrated adaptation of one of the most celebrated legends from the Mahabharata. Edited by Anant Pai with emotional cover art by Pratap Mulick, the narrative illustrates the power of sharp wisdom, devotion, and ironclad determination over destiny. By turning a traditional tale of marital fidelity into a story of raw courage, the book presents a strong female protagonist who refuses to back down even when facing the ultimate end.

title: Savitri
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha mythological comic titled Savitri is a beautifully illustrated adaptation of one of the most celebrated legends from the Mahabharata. Edited by Anant Pai with emotional cover art by Pratap Mulick, the narrative illustrates the power of sharp wisdom, devotion, and ironclad determination over destiny. By turning a traditional tale of marital fidelity into a story of raw courage, the book presents a strong female protagonist who refuses to back down even when facing the ultimate end.

title: Subhas Chandra Bose
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha historical comic titled Subhas Chandra Bose is an inspiring, illustrated tribute to one of India's most dynamic freedom fighters. Edited by Anant Pai, the narrative chronicles his journey from a brilliant student to the revolutionary leader affectionately known as 'Netaji.' By focusing on his radical stance for complete independence, the book vividly portrays his tactical genius and unyielding defiance against British colonial rule.

title: Shiva and Parvati
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha mythological comic titled Shiva and Parvati is a beautifully illustrated adaptation of one of Hindu mythology’s most iconic romances, heavily drawing from Kalidasa’s classic epic Kumara Sambhava. The script introduces readers to an epic saga of devotion, cosmic purpose, and transformation. By focusing on the journey to restore universal harmony, the narrative masterfully brings to life the timeless balance between masculine consciousness and feminine energy.

title: The Golden Mongoose
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha mythological comic titled The Golden Mongoose is a moving compilation of stories retold from the Mahabharata that explores the ancient Indian ideal of Atithidevo Bhava—treating a guest as divine. Scripted by Luis M. Fernandes with classic artwork by Pratap Mulick, the title story delivers a profound philosophical lesson on the true meaning of charity and selflessness. By contrasting a grand royal ritual with a poor family's ultimate sacrifice, the book masterfully illustrates that real generosity is measured by sincerity and intent rather than material wealth or scale.

title: Uloopi
author: Amar Chitra Katha
description: The Amar Chitra Katha mythological comic titled Uloopi is a fascinating, illustrated adaptation from the Mahabharata that highlights one of the epic's most courageous and powerful women. Originally scripted by Kamala Chandrakant, the narrative explores the legendary underwater Naga kingdoms and serpent-worshipping communities. By focusing on themes of intense love, cosmic duty, and sacrifice, the book presents Uloopi not just as a princess, but as a spiritually gifted warrior and healer capable of defying death itself.
